name: Ene Technology Inc.
summary: Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, ENE Technology Inc. operates globally, with significant operations in China and Taiwan. The company is engaged in the comprehensive lifecycle encompassing the research, design, development, production, and distribution of electronic products, alongside offering software solutions and circuit design expertise. Their product lineup features embedded controllers specifically for mobile applications, general-purpose embedded microcontrollers, a variety of peripheral devices, and tools to aid product design and development. ENE Technology also provides technical support services dedicated to product design and markets wireless charging technology.
